title: A Message for Ana
text:
Ana got a text message from her friend Lucas on Monday morning. He wanted to meet at the café after school. Ana wrote back quickly and said yes. Then she put her phone in her bag and went to class.

At the café, Lucas was not there at first. Ana sent him another message, and he replied five minutes later. He was late because his bus was slow. They laughed and ordered two hot chocolates.

questions.text: Who sent Ana a text message on Monday morning?
Why was Lucas late to the café?
How do Ana and Lucas probably feel at the end of the passage?
Why did Ana write back quickly in the first paragraph?
options: She was excited to see Lucas
She did not want to go to class

vocabulary.definition: a short written text sent by phone
answered someone in writing or speech
a small place where you can buy coffee and food

paragraph_translations: Ana recebeu uma mensagem de texto da sua amiga Lucas na segunda-feira de manhã. Ele queria se encontrar no café depois da escola. Ana respondeu rapidamente e disse que sim. Depois, ela guardou o celular na bolsa e foi para a aula.

No café, Lucas não estava lá no início. Ana mandou outra mensagem para ele, e ele respondeu cinco minutos depois. Ele estava atrasado porque o ônibus estava lento. Eles riram e pediram dois chocolates quentes.
